market_metadata.rules_secondary:
Jacob Frey must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period. 

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. market_metadata.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
market_metadata.rules_primary:
If the Hawaii’s total visitor arrivals for calendar year 2026 is above 

10.0 million, then the market resolves to Yes.
market_metadata.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is total statewide visitor arrivals for calendar year 2026, including visitors arriving by air and visitors arriving aboard out-of-state cruise ships, as reported by the State of Hawaii. It does not use visitor days, average daily census, airport passenger throughput, or arrivals to an individual island. Visitors who fly to Hawaii to board a cruise ship are already included in air arrivals and are not separately added again.

Resolution uses the first publication containing complete January–December 2026 data; subsequent revisions do not affect resolution. DBEDT’s 2025 total, for example, was 9,642,991 = 9,493,213 by air + 149,778 by cruise ship.
